# The roadmap names the examples kitchen sink as Engine 14's gate

## Context

On Mon 16 Nov 2026 the operator called the examples section as it stands on `dev` a no-go for the Engine 14 cut, and said why its plan was lost: it was not filed in epics and in the roadmap. The epic is #21140. This leaf is the roadmap's half.

## The Problem

`ROADMAP.md`, "Next: Engine 14 — The Front Door": cornerstone 1 points at #20498 and says a stranger "reads, per component family, what each example shows and why it matters, the grid first with twenty or more examples". Nothing there says that the section opens on an overview of every group, that the component examples get a workbench, that Engine 14 has a slate of examples, or that the cut waits on a read of the section. A seat that plans from the roadmap cannot find the work.

## The Architectural Reality

- `ROADMAP.md`: the gate sentence of the Engine 14 section, the cornerstone table (row 1), the session intake paragraph.
- #20498 keeps the learning half and its delivered Grid & Table overview; #21140 owns the examples section from here.

## The Fix

1. Cornerstone 1 names #21140 beside #20498, with #21140's terminal predicate for the examples.
2. A paragraph under the release gate records the read of 16 Nov and says how the examples are read on Fri 20 Nov. The gate's own sentence stays; it is the release holder's.
3. The session intake points contributors at the open leaves of #21140.
4. The deferred list names the workbench's second slice.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Cornerstone 1 links #21140 and states its predicate in one sentence.
- [ ] A paragraph under the release gate says how the examples half is read, by whom and when; the gate's own sentence is unchanged.
- [ ] The session intake names #21140's leaves.
- [ ] The workbench's second slice stands in the deferred list.
- [ ] No other row changes.

## Out of Scope

The release date; the other cornerstones; the launch plan.
